test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.

The outcome of the survey was a critical intervention to the questionaire prepared by Suraj and his committee.
solution:
The correct answer is** "questionaire".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The misspelled word in the above statement is **''questionaire''.**
 
• The correct spelling is - **Questionnaire.**
 
• The word 'questionnaire' means a list of questions that are answered by many people.
